# Xenon

> Safe file sync for Roblox: disk -> Roblox Studio live, plus a reviewed "Pull from Studio" for scripts. Only deletes scripts whose files you delete while connected (unchanged in Studio), nothing else. Luau CLI/server on Lune + a Luau Studio plugin. Rojo / Argon compatible project layout, full Wally support.

## Docs

- [Spec for AI assistants](docs/AI.md): invariants, architecture, mapping rules, model tree format, HTTP API, plugin algorithms, settings, how to extend
- [README](README.md): install, quick start, plugin UI, settings, commands, troubleshooting

## Code

- [CLI](xenon.luau): xenon init / serve / build / test / version
- [Init](src/init_project.luau) + [template/](template/): new project scaffold
- [Installers](install.ps1), [install.sh](install.sh) (source checkout); end users: `rokit add IAM9PASA/xenon`
- [Assets](src/assets.luau), [bundler](tools/bundle.luau), [release workflow](.github/workflows/release.yml): standalone binary
- [Server](src/server.luau): HTTP API on localhost
- [Mapping](src/mapping.luau): files -> Studio instance paths
- [Models](src/model.luau): .rbxm / .model.json / .txt -> JSON trees, .json / .toml -> modules
- [Plugin](plugin/xenon_plugin.luau): Studio UI, settings, diff, apply
- [Pull](src/pull.luau): Studio -> disk rules for the Pull from Studio button
- [Diff](src/diff.luau): Myers line diff for the plugin's review page
- [Tests](tests/): mapping_test.luau, wally_test.luau, diff_test.luau, pull_test.luau
